subject: general
question: Which of the following is a tributary of river Krishna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghatprabha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It originates from the Mahabaleshwar, Western Ghats.
 
• The tributaries of the river are 
 
 
• Tungabhadra, 
 
• Mallaprabha, 
 
• Koyna, 
 
• Bhima,
 
• Ghataprabha, 
 
• Yerla, 
 
• Warna,
 
• Dindi, 
 
• Musi, and 
 
• Dudhganga.
 
 
 
• Nagarjuna Sagar Dam, Koyna Hydroelectric Project, Almatti Dam, Srisailam Dam and Bhadra Dam is on the Krishna river.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pranhita is a tributary of river Godavari.

 
 
• It is a combined flow of rivers Wainganga, Penganga, Wardha.
 
 
 
• Tributaries of River Godavari are Pravara, the Purna, the Manjra, the Penganga, the Wardha, the Wainganga, the Indravati, the Maner and the Sabri.
